sources.snippet: ATCF Files Relevant source files This document explains the Automated Tropical Cyclone Forecasting (ATCF) file format and how it is processed within the pyStorms framework. ATCF files are a standardized format used by meteorological agencies to record and share tropical cyclone data.

sources.snippet: DESCRIPTION: Offical synoptic hour positions and intensity and wind radii of Tropical Cyclones in comma delimited format. Indicates the best position known at synoptic time. CATEGORY: position / intensity SPECIAL NOTES: Best track data is verified post season, so expect revisions after the season.
